# Choosing a service account: a pinned copy of Learn's decision tables

This folder is an unmodified copy of three Microsoft Learn source pages: [Securing on-premises service accounts](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/architecture/service-accounts-on-premises) (the table *Choose the right type of service account*), [Securing cloud-based service accounts](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/architecture/secure-service-accounts) (managed identity, service principal or user account, by where the service is hosted) and [Frequently asked questions about Microsoft Entra Workload ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/workload-id/workload-identities-faqs) (the Free and Premium capability table and the licensing answers). They come from [MicrosoftDocs/entra-docs](https://github.com/MicrosoftDocs/entra-docs/tree/7f78b50dce9d8cf119de57cbd6fd66e24a6c58d4/docs) at commit `7f78b50dce9d8cf119de57cbd6fd66e24a6c58d4` (October 30, 2026); the two architecture pages last changed on February 25, 2026 and the FAQ on June 15, 2026. The repository's code license (`LICENSE-CODE`) and documentation license (`LICENSE`) are both MIT.

**Why the pages, not just the tables.** The tables exist only inside these Learn pages. Pinning the pages byte for byte keeps the copy checkable against upstream. `examples/non-person-identity/tests/NpiMatrixSampleHarness.ps1` reads the tables, unmodified, at test time and evaluates them as published. Nothing is installed and nothing signs in. The [developer workbook *Building Non-Person Identity*, Chapter 03](../../../docs/project-plans/developer-workbooks/non-person-identity/03-the-migration-path-matrix-as-code.md) links Learn rather than quoting the pages.

**How it stays honest.**

- `snapshot.json` records the upstream repository, paths, commit, dates, licenses and the size and SHA-256 of every file here. Each file's git blob hash was checked against the upstream tree at that commit before the manifest was written. `scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py` fails if any file is changed, added or removed.
- The weekly source watch follows commits to each upstream page (`entra-service-accounts-onprem-choice-page-commits`, `entra-service-accounts-cloud-choice-page-commits` and `entra-workload-id-faq-page-commits` in `data/source-watch/feeds.json`) and reports each one in its issue under DW (developer workbooks).
- To move to a newer upstream commit: review the upstream change, copy the pages from that commit, regenerate `snapshot.json`, rerun `examples/non-person-identity/tests/NpiMatrix.Tests.ps1` and the Chapter 03 labs, and open a pull request. Never edit the files here; changes the program needs go in `examples/non-person-identity`.

These files keep their upstream bytes, line endings included (the FAQ page uses CRLF), so the hashes match the upstream commit.
